blocks.text: Bianca Umali said prayers played an important role in her decision to forgive Ruru Madrid after the actor admitted to cheating on her early in their relationship. Umali made the remarks during a guest appearance on “Fast Talk with Boy Abunda,” on Tuesday, Sept. 22, saying she believes people deserve second chances. “Panalangin (prayers),” she told host Boy Abunda when asked how she was able to forgive Madrid. “I think it’s not just towards Ruru. I have gotten hurt not just by people, by circumstances in life, so many times.” “And I think there’s nothing wrong with forgiving. If second chances […]...
